name: scholar-kit
description: End-to-end academic research, paper and thesis production for Codex — Turkish and English as equal first-class targets. Zero-fabrication citation discipline, evidence-card chain, claim-strength auditing, and a 7-mode AI-research failure-mode scan. Run $new-project first: it materialises the script layer, the enforcement hooks and the agents into your project.

interface.shortDescription: Academic research, writing and thesis production
interface.longDescription: 43 workflow commands and 11 knowledge skills for the whole life of a paper or thesis: literature review, evidence cards, outline, drafting, citation verification, peer-review simulation and submission. A reference never comes from the model's memory; every empirical claim binds to an evidence card; the phase gates run as hooks. Run $new-project first — the gates, scripts and agents live inside your project.
defaultPrompt: Start a new paper with $new-project paper
Run $status to see where this project stands
